title: VBM v143 conditional cross-word carry: paired-source qualification only

competing_mechanisms.A: v142b exactly as frozen: no cross-word carry
competing_mechanisms.B: v142b with six-state previous-word carry selecting bijective code-cell permutations within fixed (vowel,key,cell-length) equivalence classes
competing_mechanisms.C: state-free matched permutation selector: same codebook, six options and same state marginal distribution fitted on development source, but choice determined by a public word-index hash rather than previous plaintext

predetermined_carry: Last vowel of immediately preceding normalised source word; '-': no preceding word or no vowel; state update derived solely from independently decoded preceding ciphertext word
frozen_permutation: For each vowel state, rotate the indices in each code-cell group with identical initial key and glyph length by shift carry_index modulo group size; leave bridges, word spaces, escape usage, and all codes structurally intact
statefree_distribution: Six-category empirical previous-word carry probabilities determined on development plaintext alone, frozen before held-out Hartlieb
source_preparation: Use v142b normalized Bavarian development and untouched Hartlieb holdout as distributed; no fitting on Hartlieb
qualifying_tests: Exact independent decode of whole development and held-out Hartlieb for each of three arms
Identical ciphertext word count, total characters and per-position word lengths across arms
No new code cells, bridge pairs, state classes, source units or external event logs
Match bridge/key semantics and uniqueness of prefix-free cell parsing
A versus B versus C synthetic paired-source discriminator on Hartlieb after freezing null probabilities on development, tested against a source-aware conditional permutation null
mechanism_limit: No ciphertext-only signature can identify historical plaintext when a matched autonomous generator can reproduce the output law; a synthetic paired-source test is only an engineering test
surface_gate: Inherited v142b glyph-seam NO-GO remains in force; do not tune seams and do not promote new VMS test without distinct observable and qualified matching null
stopping_rule: If any mechanical or matched-null qualification fails, record NO-GO without retuning. Even if it passes, do not claim Voynich mechanism or SELECT resolution without an independent source anchor and fair output-only test.
